questions.question: SARS-CoV-2 antibody (serologic) testing: indications for use.

parts.text: According to IDSA, name the indications for conducting COVID-19 serology (antibody testing).

parts_raw.text: According to IDSA, name the indications for conducting COVID-19 serology (Antibody testing).

questions.model_answer: a) (1) Evaluation of suspected multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C), where IgG/total antibody is sent together with NAAT. (2) Confirmation of SARS-CoV-2 infection in a symptomatic patient with high clinical suspicion presenting late (>=2 weeks, ideally 3-4 weeks after symptom onset) whose molecular testing was repeatedly negative or could not be performed. (3) Epidemiologic/seroprevalence surveys to estimate population exposure. (4) Assessment of prior infection in a person with a compatible past illness who was never tested, when documentation is needed for clinical or public health purposes (e.g., convalescent plasma donor screening). Serology is NOT recommended for diagnosis of acute infection within the first 2 weeks of symptoms, and is not recommended to determine immunity, need for vaccination, or infection-control/return-to-work decisions.
questions.beyond_mandell: IDSA Guidelines on the Diagnosis of COVID-19: Serologic Testing (2020) - recommends IgG or total antibody 3-4 weeks after symptom onset; recommends against serology for acute diagnosis or immunity determination.

questions.question: SARS-CoV-2 serologic testing: indications per IDSA.

parts.text: List three indications as per the IDSA guidelines for use of SARS-CoV-2 serology.

parts_raw.text: List 3 indications as per the IDSA guidelines for use of SARS-CoV2 serology

questions.model_answer: a) (1) Work-up of suspected MIS-C in children (IgG/total antibody plus NAAT). (2) Confirmation of infection in a symptomatic patient with high clinical suspicion in whom NAAT was repeatedly negative or unavailable, testing IgG or total antibody at least 3-4 weeks after symptom onset. (3) Epidemiologic/seroprevalence studies to define population exposure.
questions.beyond_mandell: IDSA Guidelines on the Diagnosis of COVID-19: Serologic Testing (2020).
